articles.summary: Horizon Quantum announced the expected new members of its board of directors: Danielle Lambert, Peter Oey, Jill Turner, and Harry You. Separately, Catherine Fitzsimons will join the company as Chief Legal Officer and Company Secretary.
articles.title: Horizon Quantum Announces Expected New Board Members and Chief Legal Officer

articles.summary: Horizon Quantum closes its business combination with dMY Squared, and its shares will begin trading on the Nasdaq.
articles.title: Horizon Quantum Closes Its Business Combination with dMY Squared

articles.summary: Horizon Quantum’s achievements demonstrate its momentum in the quantum industry as it seeks to complete its proposed business combination.
articles.title: Horizon Quantum Delivers Achievements that Demonstrate Company’s Momentum in the Quantum Industry
